---
title: "SSNPT-R District Report"
output: word_document
params:
  district_code: NA
  n: NA
  suppressed: NA
  comparison: NA
  min_n: NA
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

# SSNPT-R Results: District `r params$district_code`

Number of respondents from this district: **`r params$n`**

```{r results = "asis"}
if (isTRUE(params$suppressed)) {
  cat(paste0(
    "**District-level results are not shown.** ",
    "This district had fewer than the minimum of ", params$min_n,
    " respondents required to report averages without risking the ",
    "identifiability of individual responses. This threshold protects ",
    "respondent confidentiality as described in the informed consent."
  ))
} else {
  cat("The table below compares this district's average scores to the national average across all participating districts, for each of the 8 SSNPT-R subscales (4 dimensions, each rated for how often the practice occurs and how important it is felt to be).")
}
```

```{r}
if (!isTRUE(params$suppressed)) {
  tbl <- params$comparison
  tbl$District_Mean <- round(tbl$District_Mean, 2)
  tbl$National_Mean <- round(tbl$National_Mean, 2)
  tbl$National_SD <- round(tbl$National_SD, 2)
  tbl <- tbl[, c("Subscale", "District_Mean", "National_Mean", "National_SD", "National_N")]

  flextable::flextable(tbl) |>
    flextable::set_header_labels(
      Subscale = "Subscale",
      District_Mean = "District Mean",
      National_Mean = "National Mean",
      National_SD = "National SD",
      National_N = "National N"
    ) |>
    flextable::autofit()
}
```

```{r results = "asis"}
cat("\n\n*Scale range for all subscales: 1-6. Practice subscales reflect how often the behavior occurs (1 = Never, 6 = Always). Importance subscales reflect how important the respondent feels the behavior is (1 = Not at all important, 6 = Absolutely imperative).*")
```
